import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.Transfer(%PARENT%)
control.setSourceHeader("Available members")
control.setTargetHeader("Project members")
control.setSearchPlaceholderText("Search members")
model = QStandardItemModel(control)
for name, desc in [("Lin Zhou", "Design systems"), ("Maya Ortiz", "Accessibility"), ("Noah Kim", "Release engineering"), ("Elena Rostova", "Documentation"), ("Ava Patel", "QA automation")]:
    item = QStandardItem(name)
    item.setData(name, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
    item.setData(desc, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 1)
    model.appendRow(item)
control.setModel(model)
control.setDescriptionRole(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 1)
control.setSelectedKeys(["Lin Zhou", "Elena Rostova"])
